tasks.text:
---
title: Sign up with an email and a password
status: draft
---
## Brief

Add the signup route POST /api/auth/signup to the API. It takes an email and a password as JSON and makes an account.

### The request

```json
{"email": "ada@example.com", "password": "correct-horse-battery"}
```

- The email is trimmed and lower-cased before anything else reads it. It must hold one @ with text on both sides, and be at most 254 characters.
- The password is 12 to 128 characters. It is never logged, never returned and never stored in clear text: store an argon2id hash with a random salt of 16 bytes.
- A body that is not JSON, or that holds a field other than email and password, answers 400 with {"error": "bad_request"}.

### The answers

- 201 with {"id": "<uuid>", "email": "<the email as stored>"} when the account is made. The answer sets no cookie: signing in is the next task.
- 400 with {"error": "invalid_email"} or {"error": "weak_password"} when a field breaks its rule, and the account is not made.
- 429 with {"error": "too_many_requests"} after 10 signups from one address in one minute.

### Storage

The accounts table holds id (uuid, primary key), email (text, unique), password_hash (text) and created_at (timestamptz, set by the database). The migration that creates it is part of this task, and it runs before the route serves.

#### Errors the route must not leak

The route never says whether an email is taken through timing: hash the password before the uniqueness check, every time. Log the request id and the answer's status, never the body.

A second signup with the same email answers 409 and makes no second account.
tasks.contract:
openapi: 3.0.3
info:
  title: Photo Share auth
  version: 1.0.0
paths:
  /api/auth/signup:
    post:
      summary: Make an account from an email and a password.
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              additionalProperties: false
              required: [email, password]
              properties:
                email: { type: string, maxLength: 254 }
                password: { type: string, minLength: 12, maxLength: 128 }
      responses:
        '201':
          description: The account is made.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                required: [id, email]
                properties:
                  id: { type: string, format: uuid }
                  email: { type: string }
        '400':
          description: "A field breaks its rule: bad_request, invalid_email or weak_password. A body like ```{}``` is bad_request."
        '409':
          description: The email has an account already.
        '429':
          description: Too many signups from one address.

notes: The run-1 T002 shape: its text and contract are what run 1 lost.
